lesson.title: Notes, Dictionaries & Practice
lesson.subtitle: Taking notes, using dictionaries, and improving your level
lesson.description: Talk about study tools, taking notes, reviewing lessons, solving hard problems, and raising your language level.

learning_objectives: Name study tools: 笔记, 笔记本, 词典, 字典, 课本, 课文, and 铅笔.
Describe study actions: 记, 复习, 练, 练习, and doing 作业.
Evaluate progress and difficulty with 常用, 常见, 句子, 难题, 水平, and 提高.

metadata.audience: HSK 3.0 Level 3 learners with Level 1-2 foundations

overview.topic_description: Practical study vocabulary for textbooks, dictionaries, notes, practice, and improvement.
overview.focus: Use 复习 for reviewing material and 提高水平 for raising one’s level.

questions.prompt: According to the reading, why is just reading the textbook not enough?
questions.answer: You should also look up new words in a dictionary, note down useful sentences, and review/practice regularly.
questions.explanation: The passage recommends using a dictionary, keeping a notebook, and reviewing on weekends.

questions.prompt: Write two sentences about how you study Chinese using 复习, 笔记, or 提高.
questions.answer: 我每天晚上复习课堂笔记，希望能尽快提高汉语水平。
questions.explanation: Use 复习笔记 and 提高水平.
作业 means homework or assignment.
复习 means to review previously learned material.
笔记本 is the notebook itself.

dialogue.title: Preparing for Tomorrow’s Quiz
dialogue.context_en: Two classmates review a lesson text and share study tips.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 今天的作业好多啊，你复习完第三课的课文了吗？
turns.pinyin: Jīntiān de zuòyè hǎoduō a, nǐ fùxí wán dì-sān kè de kèwén le ma?
turns.english: There’s so much homework today—have you finished reviewing Lesson 3’s text?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 刚复习完。我用铅笔在课本上记了些常用的句子。
turns.pinyin: Gāng fùxí wán. Wǒ yòng qiānbǐ zài kèběn shàng jì le xiē cháng yòng de jùzi.
turns.english: Just finished. I used a pencil to note down some commonly used sentences in the textbook.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 这个办法真好！遇到不认识的字怎么办？
turns.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ zhēn hǎo! Yùdào bú rènshi de zì zěnme bàn?
turns.english: That’s a great method! What do you do when you run into characters you don’t know?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 我会查字典或者词典，再多做练习，这样汉语水平提高得很快。
turns.pinyin: Wǒ huì chá zìdiǎn huòzhě cídiǎn, zài duō zuò liànxí, zhèyàng Hànyǔ shuǐpíng tígāo de hěn kuài.
turns.english: I look them up in a character or word dictionary and do more exercises—that way my Chinese level improves fast.

patterns.title: Raising your level with 提高
patterns.explanation_en: Pair 提高 (tígāo) with 水平 (shuǐpíng) or 成绩 to talk about improving a skill or score.

examples.hanzi: 多听多说能提高口语水平。
examples.pinyin: Duō tīng duō shuō néng tígāo kǒuyǔ shuǐpíng.
examples.english: Listening and speaking more can improve your spoken language level.

examples.hanzi: 每天写日记帮助我提高了写作水平。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān xiě rìjì bāngzhù wǒ tígāo le xiězuò shuǐpíng.
examples.english: Writing a diary every day helped me raise my writing level.

patterns.title: Noting things down in a notebook
patterns.explanation_en: Use 把 + notes + 记在 + 笔记本上 or 记笔记 to talk about taking study notes.
patterns.pattern_hanzi: 把 + <Word / Sentence> + 记在 + 笔记本上
patterns.pattern_pinyin: bǎ + <Word / Sentence> + jì zài + bǐjìběn shàng

examples.hanzi: 我把常见的难题都记在了笔记本上。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ cháng jiàn de nántí dōu jì zài le bǐjìběn shàng.
examples.english: I wrote down all the common difficult problems in my notebook.

examples.hanzi: 上课时他一边听一边认真记笔记。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè shí tā yìbiān tīng yìbiān rènzhēn jì bǐjì.
examples.english: During class he listened while carefully taking notes.

guided_building.instruction_en: Talk about study tools, practice, and improvement.

model.hanzi: 每天晚上我都先做作业，再复习课文。
model.pinyin: Měitiān wǎnshang wǒ dōu xiān zuò zuòyè, zài fùxí kèwén.
model.english: Every evening I do my homework first, then review the lesson text.

substitutions.cue_en: Say you need to buy a new notebook and two pencils.

model_answer.hanzi: 我要买一个新笔记本和两支铅笔。
model_answer.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi yí ge xīn bǐjìběn hé liǎng zhī qiānbǐ.
model_answer.english: I need to buy a new notebook and two pencils.

substitutions.cue_en: Say this is a commonly used Chinese sentence.

model_answer.hanzi: 这是一个非常常用的汉语句子。
model_answer.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge fēicháng cháng yòng de Hànyǔ jùzi.
model_answer.english: This is a very commonly used Chinese sentence.

substitutions.cue_en: Say you practice speaking Chinese every morning.

model_answer.hanzi: 我每天早上都练说汉语。
model_answer.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang dōu liàn shuō Hànyǔ.
model_answer.english: I practice speaking Chinese every morning.

paragraphs.hanzi: 学外语的时候，光看课本是不够的。每学完一篇课文，最好用词典查一查生词的用法。
paragraphs.pinyin: Xué wàiyǔ de shíhou, guāng kàn kèběn shì búgòu de. Měi xué wán yì piān kèwén, zuìhǎo yòng cídiǎn chá yì chá shēngcí de yòngfǎ.
paragraphs.english: When studying a foreign language, just reading the textbook is not enough. After finishing each lesson text, it is best to check the usage of new words in a dictionary.

paragraphs.hanzi: 然后把常用的句子记在笔记本里，周末再认真复习一遍。坚持练习，语言水平自然会慢慢提高。
paragraphs.pinyin: Ránhòu bǎ cháng yòng de jùzi jì zài bǐjìběn lǐ, zhōumò zài rènzhēn fùxí yí biàn. Jiānchí liànxí, yǔyán shuǐpíng zìrán huì mànmàn tígāo.
paragraphs.english: Then write the commonly used sentences in a notebook, and review them carefully once more on the weekend. Keep practicing, and your language level will naturally rise.

questions.prompt_en: What should you do after finishing each lesson text?
questions.answer_en: Check the usage of new words in a dictionary and write commonly used sentences in a notebook.

questions.prompt_en: What happens if you keep practicing and reviewing?
questions.answer_en: Your language level will naturally improve.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Describe what study tools you keep on your desk.

model_answer.hanzi: 我的桌子上放着课本、笔记本、铅笔和一本词典。
model_answer.pinyin: Wǒ de zhuōzi shàng fàng zhe kèběn, bǐjìběn, qiānbǐ hé yì běn cídiǎn.
model_answer.english: On my desk are a textbook, a notebook, a pencil, and a dictionary.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Explain how you solve a hard problem (难题) in your homework.

model_answer.hanzi: 遇到难题时，我会先复习笔记，再请教老师。
model_answer.pinyin: Yùdào nántí shí, wǒ huì xiān fùxí bǐjì, zài qǐngjiào lǎoshī.
model_answer.english: When I run into a hard problem, I review my notes first and then ask the teacher.

teaching_plan.common_pitfall: 字典 is a character dictionary (by single 字), while 词典 is a word/phrase dictionary (by 词). Also, 笔记 means "notes", whereas 笔记本 means "notebook" (or laptop).
teaching_plan.pronunciation_focus: 复习 (fùxí) moves from fourth tone to second tone; 练习 (liànxí) also moves from fourth tone to second tone.
